text:
Olivia Chen: Heads up — after last night's fw rollout (bnxt fw 2.1.7) we're seeing intermittent interface flaps and rx overruns on c7i instances in us-west-2. Training clusters hit throughput drops. :frowning_face:
Olivia Chen: dmesg snippet from one host:
```
bnxt 0000:06:00.0: eth0: Rx completion error: queue 3 rx_overrun
bnxt 0000:06:00.0: eth0: RX Error count 324
bnxt 0000:06:00.0: eth0: link state changed to UP
```
Samir Patel: can you paste `ethtool -S eth0` / counters?
Olivia Chen: ethtool -S output (trimmed):
```
rx_packets: 12345678
rx_errors: 324
rx_over_errors: 200
rx_dropped: 324
tx_packets: 9876543
tx_errors: 0
```
Rajiv Menon: rx_overruns + dropped sounds like ring exhaustion. Are we using jumbo frames (MTU 9000) on these nodes?
Maria Gomez: yes for performance tests we set MTU 9000. I just flipped one canary node to 1500 and the flaps stopped for ~2h. also saw logs that said "bnxt rx ring full". :eyes:
Ashley Wright: is this isolated to bnxt (Broadcom) NICs or also seen on mlx5?
Olivia Chen: only on c7i (bnxt) so far, no reports from g6gn/mlx5 pools.
Cheng Li: likely firmware regression in 2.1.7 affecting completion handling under jumbo frames. Recommend rollback to fw 2.1.5 on affected pool and run canary. Also collect `tcpdump -w` for a burst window and attach to bug.
Olivia Chen: can someone trigger rollback for pool infra-train-usw2-02? It's served by c7i-bnxt nodes.
deploy-bot: rollback job `bnxt-fw-rollover/infra-train-usw2-02` queued by Ashley Wright at 2026-03-18T03:40:00Z.
Samir Patel: short-term mitigation: disable GRO/LRO and reduce RX ring size pressure. e.g. `ethtool -K eth0 gro off lro off` and add `net.core.rmem_max` tweak. helped reduce bursts in my lab.
Olivia Chen: I applied `gro off` on one host — interface stabilized but throughput hit ~10% lower. good enough for short-term.
Rajiv Menon: please open a vendor ticket with Broadcom/bnxt driver: include ethtool -S, dmesg, kernel version, exact fw image, and a pcap of a failure window.
Maria Gomez: opened ticket #BZ-3372 with logs and pcap attached. linked to internal incident.
Ashley Wright: scheduling maintenance window to migrate training traffic off the pool at 03:30 UTC and roll back fw. will communicate to customers. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: monitoring: increased sensitivity on `net.if.rx_errors` for c7i pools; alerting for >5 errors/min per host.
Cheng Li: after rollback to 2.1.5 can we run soak with MTU 9000 and synthetic high-packet-rate tests to confirm? if stable, we'll plan gradual re-roll with a guarded canary.
Olivia Chen: yes — plan sounds good. leaving monitoring on — ping me if any host shows new spikes. :eyes:
